object.attr: derived: a misspelt directive, or one from a newer Mellon, is skipped without a sign; the other rules file checks catch only names and values (CF-C9, CF-C35, review Q5).
object.description: If a document's rules file holds an element or XML attribute that the on-disk format doesn't define, Mellon shall report the validation error RULEFILE_UNKNOWN_ELEMENT.
